mechanism: Artifact-identity mass is not invariant to package duplication/grouping over a fixed content-addressed primitive semantic basis. In a partial-overlap primitive support hypergraph, no pre-context single-package additive-mass controller can preserve all exclusive support while equalizing support-cell exposure. Therefore a representation-invariant controller must factor through a taxonomy-independent quotient of semantic context space before mapping mass/credit back to the current package representation.

upstream_curriculum: precomputed support/applicability fingerprints from frozen first-party validators or released task-support evidence

the same raw pre-task quality/exploration/decay evidence available to native baselines; SQC deterministically aggregates it into content-addressed primitive/support-cell state rather than treating duplicate package IDs as independent state

upstream_forbidden_baseline_information: the generated task that does not yet exist
decision_time_information_contract.post_context_retrieval_credit: Task context/outcome becomes available and must be shared identically with contextual baselines.

algorithm.name: Freeze primitive basis and build the support quotient
algorithm.description: Identify primitive implementations by content-addressed semantic-contract fingerprints that exclude mutable stats. Freeze each primitive support predicate V_u from its first-party validator. Define x ~_U x' iff every frozen primitive validator gives the same support bit on x and x'; the support cells are the quotient C_U=X/~_U. Package IDs/grouping do not enter this equivalence relation, and no learned similarity threshold is tuned on outcomes.

algorithm.name: Allocate semantic control mass
algorithm.description: Place curriculum/retrieval/update mass on support atoms under a frozen semantic prior. Package multiplicity cannot create new atom mass.

algorithm.name: Choose primitive implementation conditionally
algorithm.description: Within a support cell c, distribute its unit mass among compatible content-addressed primitives u in sigma_U(c) using only the same raw pre-decision quality/exploration evidence available to baselines after deterministic primitive-level aggregation; primitive responsibilities sum to one. Duplicate package IDs do not create independent quality/exploration state. The current taxonomy then only wraps/groups those unchanged primitives.

algorithm.name: Realize upstream generation with a shared non-novel backend
algorithm.description: For generative curricula, the selected support atom must constrain realization rather than collapse back to an unconstrained global package draw. Use a first-party support-conditioned proposer interface if the author exposes one; otherwise use validator-gated/rejection realization under a preregistered matched call budget. This realization backend is not claimed as novel. If neither faithful backend exists, upstream quotient control is not operationally identified on that substrate.

algorithm.name: Quotient credit
algorithm.description: After independently verified feedback, update content-addressed primitive/support-cell state once and distribute responsibility across compatible primitives with total responsibility one. Package-level bookkeeping is a derived view. Identity duplication/grouping cannot multiply total future semantic credit or create an independent exploration counter.

algorithm.name: Transformation audit
algorithm.description: Before scale-up, apply only the claimed semantics-preserving representation transformations over the frozen primitive set: identity duplication and package grouping/ungrouping. Require the realized support-cell control process to remain within preregistered distance tolerance while primitive content/support and semantic coverage remain unchanged. Do not claim arbitrary semantic decomposition of a primitive into new subskills.

Any randomized same-information controller therefore induces only a categorical package-weight vector at the frozen state, so the tight global-weight lower bound applies to the full rule/MLP/bandit/neural single-package class.

strongest_same_information_baselines.role: Use rejection sampling as the default generic realization implementation when no native support-conditioned proposer exists. Do not claim a specialized SQC realization advantage over this backend.

strongest_same_information_baselines.stop_rule: If it matches SQC on retrieval/credit invariance and downstream utility, drop that SQC component.

formal_targets: Content-addressed primitive-basis definition and representation channel: package selection p_T(s|z) plus within-package responsibility rho_T(u|s,z) induces normalized primitive mass m_T(u|z).

Tight mandatory-overlap lower bound on additive eligibility exposure E_T(c|z)=sum_{u in sigma_U(c)}m_T(u|z): two exclusive cells plus one shared cell force max/min >=2. The released Skill-SP graph supplies two witnesses and the LP optimum equals 2.

Frozen-state decision-time reduction: every randomized same-information controller choosing exactly one package before task generation induces a categorical p_T(s|z) pointwise in z; this does not identify a whole longitudinal adaptive policy.
Support-quotient invariance proposition on C_U=X/~_U, where equal frozen primitive support signatures define the equivalence relation. Exact clones/grouping cannot create new quotient cells.
Credit conservation proposition: total semantic credit is invariant to package duplication/grouping when primitive responsibility weights sum to one.
method_success_condition: The support-quotient control core must remove the qualified native taxonomy sensitivity on a real/public dynamic substrate while using a faithful shared realization backend, preserving semantic coverage and staying within the matched proposer/validator call and evolution-utility budget. Control-plane algebra alone is not enough for C3.
method_failure_conditions: faithful qualified native dynamic substrate shows no representation sensitivity
support-quotient control cannot be realized within the matched proposer/validator call budget
support-quotient control obtains invariance only by reducing semantic coverage or verified evolution utility
the support fingerprints or quotient prior use information unavailable at the upstream decision time
contextual router matches the optional post-context retrieval/credit extension, in which case that extension is dropped
next_action: Freeze one faithful author-workflow P0 in which rejection/validator gating is a shared backend, not a competing claimed method. Test only native taxonomy sensitivity plus whether support-quotient control removes it within matched coverage/call/utility constraints. Do not train an upstream neural single-package baseline; that class is already analytically reduced.
